claims.observation: The tail cap is a rounded, roughly hemispherical closure at the same diameter as the barrel, with a cross-hatch knurl pattern visible on it, distinct from the main grip knurl band.
A diamond-pattern knurled grip band occupies roughly the middle third of the barrel length, bounded by smooth polished barrel sections both toward the tail and toward the head.
A single oval/lozenge-shaped push-button switch sits on the smooth barrel section immediately behind (tailward of) the knurled grip band, not within the knurled band itself.

limitations: Oblique perspective photo, not orthographic -- proportions along the visible axis are read by eye and anchored to the official length/diameter numbers above, not measured pixel-for-pixel.
Only one viewing angle retained; the far side of the barrel/head is not directly observed.
